Hello ojw28,

You can get issue by follow the below step ;

### **Step : ### 1**

Please download and install application from play store and application url is : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.videoplayer.easylife4u in any of samsung device or other device.

### **Step : ### 2**

After that download  high resolution  MKV file of more than 500 MB 

### **Step : ###  3**

Open application you have installed in mobile device by following the step 1

### **Step : ###  4**

Choose MKV file downloaded by follow the step 3.

### **Step : ### 5**

After playing the MKV video in application and skip video by dragging the seek bar to approximately half of the video.

Now you got the issue that player take little bit time to load & play the video and video got stuck for that time.

If we rewind the video then we got same issue and its really bad experience for user

**_Comparison_**

If we play **MP4** video and follow step 5 then player working perfectly without any issue

Check below URL that produce the MKV file issue with the big video and URL is : https://drive.google.com/file/d/1c3sitERi_6fo2e_WjyI7FpVTTqsNXWYW/view?usp=sharing

Thanks!!

The issue does not reproduce for me. Are you sure this isn't a device specific problem. Note that the issue template requests that you provide details about which device you're using, which you have not done. If you were to properly fill out our issue template then we'd be more likely to be able to help!

Just check your official exoplayer app and play video from playlist then you got the issue of player video rendering stop for some time if we skip video above the buffer and if you rewind the video then audio is coming but video not playing in exoplayer approximately for 5 second.

This is really bad experience of any user play the local video and he need to wait for 5 to 10 second after rewind or forward video 

Same issue occur in official video player and you can check video that is attached below

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yWbnKoqLDehfqlx4KB0WuZdoaKRlWame/view?usp=sharing

I have already checked that, and I do not see any issues. It's unclear what the issue is from the video you've attached, either (audio seems to be choppy, but I think that's more likely to do with the way you captured this video than to be an actual issue with playback).

Is the issue simply that resuming after a seek is not immediate? It's expected that resuming wont be immediate for the sample in the demo app, because it's not a local file, and therefore a network request is needed to satisfy the seek.

If your issue is that a _local_ file is also taking a long time to resume after a seek, you need to provide a local file that reproduces this issue. Along with properly filling out the issue template to avoid us wasting time with lots of round trip messages.
